data.name: NoRealData
data.value: All persons there are fictitious – please do not enter real data.

data.name: Login_Intro
data.value: You are now leaving the BürgerPortal for the sign-in page of a BundID simulator – a test system, not the real BundID.

data.name: Login_Step1
data.value: You choose a fictitious test person, an identification method (e.g. user name, ELSTER, online ID card) and a "business context" – the same context means the same person.

data.name: Login_Step2
data.value: The simulator sends the BürgerPortal a digitally signed confirmation (SAML) with the test person's data. The BürgerPortal verifies it and signs you in.

data.name: Login_Real
data.value: You would be redirected to the BundID (id.bund.de) and identify yourself with your own BundID account – with user name and password, ELSTER certificate or online ID card. The BundID would then transmit your real data to the BürgerPortal.

data.name: Postfach_Intro
data.value: You are now going to a replica of the BundID mailbox. It belongs to the BundID simulator of this student project and is not a real mailbox.

data.name: Postfach_Step1
data.value: The mailbox signs in with the BundID in the background. Since you are already signed in there, this usually happens without choosing a person again (single sign-on; the session lasts 30 minutes).

data.name: Postfach_Step2
data.value: It shows the messages sent to your Postkorb handle – for example confirmations of appointments and applications from the BürgerPortal.

data.name: Postfach_Real
data.value: The mailbox is part of your BundID account at id.bund.de. Authorities deliver their messages via the central citizen mailbox (ZBP).

data.name: StepUp_Note
data.value: This function requires the trust level "substantial". In the simulator, choose ELSTER, Smart-eID or eID (online ID card) – "user name" is no longer offered there.
